# uwbranding

UW–Madison brand identity for R and Quarto: ggplot2 themes, color
scales, and Quarto document templates.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("yourname/uwbranding")
```

## Fonts

All UW brand fonts are free Google Fonts. Install them as system fonts
so XeLaTeX and ggplot2 can find them.

| Font | Role | Download |
|----|----|----|
| Crimson Pro | Body text (PDF) | <https://brand.wisc.edu/resource/crimson-pro-font/> |
| Red Hat Display | Headings | <https://brand.wisc.edu/resource/red-hat-display-font/> |
| Red Hat Text | Labels, slides | <https://brand.wisc.edu/resource/red-hat-text-font/> |

## ggplot2 themes

``` r

library(uwbranding)
library(ggplot2)

# Light theme (PDF documents, light slides)
ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy, color = drv)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_uw() +
  theme_uw()

# Dark theme (dark slides, poster panels)
ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy, color = drv)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_uw_dark() +
  theme_uw_dark()               # style = "black" (default) or "red"
```

### Scales at a glance

| Function | Aesthetic | Background |
|----|----|----|
| [`scale_color_uw()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/scale_color_uw.md) / [`scale_fill_uw()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/scale_fill_uw.md) | discrete | light |
| [`scale_color_uw_c()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/scale_color_uw_c.md) / [`scale_fill_uw_c()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/scale_color_uw_c.md) | continuous | light |
| [`scale_color_uw_dark()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/scale_color_uw_dark.md) / [`scale_fill_uw_dark()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/scale_color_uw_dark.md) | discrete | dark |
| [`scale_color_uw_dark_c()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/scale_color_uw_dark_c.md) / [`scale_fill_uw_dark_c()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/scale_color_uw_dark_c.md) | continuous | dark |

### Brand colors

``` r

uw_colors                          # full named vector
uw_color("badger_red")             # "#C5050C"
uw_color("badger_red", "yellow")   # named vector of two
```

## Quarto templates

Copy template files into any project directory:

``` r

use_uw_pdf()        # uw-brand.tex + _quarto.yml + template.qmd
use_uw_revealjs()   # _uw-light.scss + _uw-dark.scss + template.qmd
use_uw_beamer()     # _uw-beamer-preamble.tex + title.tex + template.qmd
```

All three default to the current working directory. Pass
`path = "slides"` etc. to copy into a subdirectory. Use
`overwrite = TRUE` to replace existing files.

### Switching light ↔︎ dark

**RevealJS** — swap one line in the template YAML and match the setup
chunk:

``` yaml
theme: [default, _uw-light.scss]   # light
theme: [default, _uw-dark.scss]    # dark
```

``` r

theme_set(theme_uw(base_size = 14))       # light
theme_set(theme_uw_dark(base_size = 14))  # dark
```

**Beamer** — flip one line in `_uw-beamer-preamble.tex`:

``` latex
\uwdarkfalse   % light (default)
\uwdarktrue    % dark
```

## Brand resources

- Colors: <https://brand.wisc.edu/visual-identity/colors/>
- Typography: <https://brand.wisc.edu/visual-identity/typography/>
- Icons & illustrations:
  <https://brand.wisc.edu/visual-identity/graphics-and-icons/>

# Package index

## Brand Colors

Named color vectors and lookup helpers for UW–Madison brand colors.

- [`uw_colors`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/uw_colors.md)
  : UW–Madison brand colors
- [`uw_color()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/uw_color.md)
  : Look up UW–Madison brand colors by name

## Color Palettes

Ordered palettes for light and dark backgrounds, and their palette
functions.

- [`uw_palette_discrete`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/uw_palette_discrete.md)
  : UW–Madison discrete palette for light backgrounds
- [`uw_palette_dark`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/uw_palette_dark.md)
  : UW–Madison discrete palette for dark backgrounds
- [`uw_pal()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/uw_pal.md)
  : UW brand discrete palette function for light backgrounds
- [`uw_pal_dark()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/uw_pal_dark.md)
  : UW brand discrete palette function for dark backgrounds

## ggplot2 Themes

Complete ggplot2 themes conforming to UW–Madison brand identity.

- [`theme_uw()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/theme_uw.md)
  : UW–Madison ggplot2 theme (light)
- [`theme_uw_dark()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/theme_uw_dark.md)
  : UW–Madison ggplot2 theme (dark)

## ggplot2 Scales — Light Background

Discrete and continuous color/fill scales for plots on light/white
backgrounds.

- [`scale_color_uw()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/scale_color_uw.md)
  [`scale_colour_uw()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/scale_color_uw.md)
  : UW brand discrete color scale
- [`scale_fill_uw()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/scale_fill_uw.md)
  : UW brand discrete fill scale
- [`scale_color_uw_c()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/scale_color_uw_c.md)
  [`scale_colour_uw_c()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/scale_color_uw_c.md)
  [`scale_fill_uw_c()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/scale_color_uw_c.md)
  : UW brand sequential color scale (continuous, light backgrounds)

## ggplot2 Scales — Dark Background

Discrete and continuous color/fill scales for plots on dark backgrounds.

- [`scale_color_uw_dark()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/scale_color_uw_dark.md)
  [`scale_colour_uw_dark()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/scale_color_uw_dark.md)
  [`scale_fill_uw_dark()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/scale_color_uw_dark.md)
  : UW brand discrete color scale for dark backgrounds
- [`scale_color_uw_dark_c()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/scale_color_uw_dark_c.md)
  [`scale_colour_uw_dark_c()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/scale_color_uw_dark_c.md)
  [`scale_fill_uw_dark_c()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/scale_color_uw_dark_c.md)
  : UW brand sequential color scale for dark backgrounds (continuous)

## Quarto Templates

Copy UW–Madison branded Quarto templates into a project.

- [`use_uw_pdf()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/use_uw.md)
  [`use_uw_revealjs()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/use_uw.md)
  [`use_uw_beamer()`](https://cdmuir.github.io/uwbranding/reference/use_uw.md)
  : Copy UW brand Quarto templates into the current project

  : uwbranding: UW-Madison Brand Identity for R and Quarto
